productDetail.platformBody: This device can connect to the Anshouhu Cloud Platform for multi-device data aggregation, remote care and organization-level management.
productDetail.privacyBadgeDesc: The top sensor is an ambient infrared sensing window. The device contains zero cameras, zero image sensors, and zero microphones, physically preventing audio and video recording to protect privacy and dignity.

home.heroLead: Zhongke Anqiao is a sensing technology company. For elderly-care institutions, healthcare organizations and home care settings, we deliver vital-sign and fall-sensing systems with no cameras and no microphones — sensing only, never recording images.
home.heroAffiliation: Tsinghua-derived sensing algorithms · Incubated by Suzhou Institute of Biomedical Engineering and Technology, CAS

principles.title: What we sense
principles.body: Respiration, heart rate, body movement, bed exit and falls — captured through micro-Doppler reflection of electromagnetic waves on the human body. No wearables, no skin contact, no cooperation required from the person being cared for.

principles.title: How we compute
principles.body: Raw signals are filtered and feature-extracted locally on the edge chip, with algorithms originating from Tsinghua sleep-sensing research. Institutions receive only structured events and values, never raw waveforms.

principles.title: Why zero privacy risk
principles.body: The device contains no optical camera and no microphone, and generates no image or audio. 'Being filmed or recorded' is physically impossible — a hardware fact, not a software promise.

home.casesBody: We do not fabricate case studies. Zhongke Anqiao is in its demonstration-deployment phase: the first pilots target elderly-care institutions and integrated medical-eldercare facilities in the Yangtze River Delta, validating the system on real beds, real alerts and real workflows.
home.casesNote: Pilot institutions receive: factory-price device quotas, on-site commissioning by factory engineers, a 12-month whole-unit warranty, and a co-signed acceptance report.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.lead: Tsinghua-derived Technology · Multi-modal contactless monitoring · Precision Health Monitoring
aboutPage.introBody: Zhongke Anqiao (Suzhou) Technology Co., Ltd. integrates R&D and sales of medical devices, office intelligence, health management, smart medical integration, elderly rehabilitation, mobile applications and smart prevention health-monitoring software. Founded in 2023, the company is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
aboutPage.techBody: The company is building a digital health management center and a professional R&D team, progressively developing key devices covering smart health fast-pass, contactless rapid health screening, health mother-and-child units and microfluidic health fast-pass. In deep cooperation with Suzhou Institute of Biomedical Engineering, it jointly develops routine monitoring and promotion programs for children's and adolescents' health, adopts Tsinghua's sleep mmWave radar technology, and launches data-driven medical-eldercare integrated sleep monitoring R&D — officially initiating the core AI Health Guardian device R&D program.

aboutPage.certBody: The company holds a medical device business filing certificate (qualified to sell Class II medical devices).
aboutPage.teamBody: Zhongke Anqiao's core R&D team comes from renowned universities and research institutions, including Tsinghua University and Suzhou Institute of Biomedical Engineering and Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, with deep industry expertise in microwave RF engineering, bioradar signal processing and medical health algorithms.

history.title: Company founded
history.body: Founded in Suzhou, the company established a digital health-management center and a professional R&D team, progressively refining key devices: smart-health rapid channel, contactless rapid screening, health parent-child device and microfluidic health rapid channel.

history.title: Core project initiated
history.body: Innovatively launched the Elderly Health Guardian series; in-depth cooperation with Suzhou Institute of Biomedical Engineering and Technology on routine child and adolescent health monitoring; adopted Tsinghua's sleep mmWave radar technology and initiated data-driven medical-eldercare sleep monitoring R&D; the core AI Health Guardian project was formally launched.

history.title: Product matrix complete
history.body: Leveraging R&D outcomes from the Shenzhen Advanced Technology Research Institute, independently completed the microfluidic white-blood-cell analyzer and multi-function smart nursing-bed software; achieved modular embedding of life-monitoring functions, developed transfer equipment, pulse-massage chairs and more; in deep cooperation with Southeast University on core components for a high-frequency ECG waiting-room chair.
